parsed.g: Find the number of reviews that the store has received that mention the term 'decent'
P_t: Navigated to the Magento Admin Dashboard
Navigated to Marketing > User Content > All Reviews page
R_t: Clear the corrupted filter text in the Review textbox (currently contains 'disapdecentsatisfiedpoisatisfiednted')
Enter only 'decent' in the Review filter textbox
Click the Search button to execute the filter
Read the number of records found from the results
parsed.e_t: The agent is on the Reviews page at http://172.185.52.29:7780/admin/review/product/index/filter/... The page shows '0 records found'. The Review filter textbox (node 12587) contains the corrupted string 'disapdecentsatisfiedpoisatisfiednted' (not just 'decent'). The table shows 'We couldn't find any records.' The filter was applied with this corrupted string, which is why no results are returned.
C: The Review filter textbox must contain only the word 'decent' (not appended to other text) before searching
The filter textbox must be cleared before typing the correct search term

F_t.cause: The type action appended 'decent' to existing text in the textbox. The textbox already contained 'disapsatisfiedpoisatisfiednted' (from prior state), resulting in 'disapdecentsatisfiedpoisatisfiednted' as shown in node 3058 in the step 3 observation.

Search was executed with the corrupted filter string 'disapdecentsatisfiedpoisatisfiednted' in the Review textbox (node 3058), not just 'decent'. This caused 0 records to be found instead of the correct count.

The type action again appended 'decent' to the already-corrupted string in the textbox. Per ground-truth DOM node 12587, the textbox still shows 'disapdecentsatisfiedpoisatisfiednted', and the result remains '0 records found'.

K_t: The Reviews page is accessible via Marketing > User Content > All Reviews at http://172.185.52.29:7780/admin/review/product/index/
The Review filter textbox (node 12587) currently contains 'disapdecentsatisfiedpoisatisfiednted' — a corrupted string from repeated appending of 'decent'
The type action appends text to existing content rather than replacing it; the textbox must be cleared first
The current search result shows 0 records found, which is incorrect due to the corrupted filter string
To get the correct count, the Review textbox must be cleared and only 'decent' entered before clicking Search
